quests.title: Serialized first human soul-healing achievement checkpoint

storySteps.title: Pick up Euric's global soul-control token
Wait 450 seconds for Euric's first village visit
Read Euric's note in his room
Hear Gerry and Smiler argue in the soul room
Purchase Sins III and converge on Euric's next request
Optionally insert the pride shard into the stained glass
Ask Euric which two sins need curing next
Ask Clotho how to obtain ash for Wrath
Give Clotho two jars of honey and have her drop the unusual ash
Ask Clotho for the mysterious sauce recipe
Cook the first mysterious sauce and stage the Merchant handoff
Give the ash to the Inquisitor and charge the Wrath shard
Offer the sauce to the Merchant and charge the Gluttony shard
